import sys

class Solver:
    def solve(self, inp, out):
        n = int(inp.readline())
        s = inp.readline().strip()
        winpars = 0
        longest = 0
        i = 0
        j = 0
        while "__" in s:
            s = s.replace("__", "_")
        n = len(s)
        while i < n and s[i] != '(':
            i += 1
            if i < n and s[i] == '(':
                j = i
                while j < n and s[j] != ')':
                    j += 1
                if j < n and s[j] == ')':
                    temp = s[i+1:j]
                    if "_" not in temp and len(temp) > 0:
                        winpars += 1
                    else:
                        parts = temp.split("_")
                        winpars += len([p for p in parts if p])
                    i = j
        while '(' in s or ')' in s:
            import re
            s = re.sub(r'\([^\(]*\)', '_', s)
        parts = s.split("_")
        for temp in parts:
            if len(temp) > longest:
                longest = len(temp)
        out.write(f"{longest} {winpars}\n")

def main():
    inp = sys.stdin
    out = sys.stdout
    s = Solver()
    s.solve(inp, out)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
